title.uz: Past Simple: savol va inkor bilan

theory.uz:
Past Simple — o‘tgan zamonda tugagan ish: I visited my aunt last week.
To‘g‘ri fe’llar -ed oladi: work → worked, live → lived, study → studied, drop → dropped.
Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar yodlanadi: take → took, write → wrote, find → found, bring → brought, teach → taught.
Inkor: didn't + fe’lning oddiy shakli: We didn't go out.  Savol: Did you enjoy it? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
So‘roq so‘zi bilan: Where did you go? What did she buy? When did they arrive?

Sayohat so‘zlari: holiday (ta’til), trip / journey (safar), suitcase (chamadon), ticket (chipta),
passport, luggage (yuk), airport, railway station (vokzal), hotel (mehmonxona), map (xarita), guide (gid).
by + transport: by train, by plane, by car, by bus;  piyoda esa — on foot.
Iboralar: go on holiday, go sightseeing, pack a suitcase, book a hotel, take photos, miss the train.
Misol: Last summer we went to Samarkand by train. We stayed in a hotel and took a lot of photos.

Ravish fe’lni tasvirlaydi — ish QANDAY bajariladi? (How?)
Sifat + -ly: quick → quickly, slow → slowly, quiet → quietly, careful → carefully, loud → loudly.
-y → -ily: easy → easily, happy → happily;  -le → -ly: gentle → gently.
Maxsus: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard (hardly — “deyarli … emas” degani, boshqa so‘z!).
Sifat otni, ravish fe’lni tasvirlaydi: She is a careful driver. — She drives carefully.

Uzunroq so‘zlarni yozishda qoidalarga e’tibor bering:
• Qo‘sh undosh: rabbit, carrot, butterfly, balloon.
• Harf birikmalari: ph = f (dolphin), wh (whale), ck (clock), igh (lightning).
• Eshitilmaydigan harflar: k (knife), w (write), b (lamb).
Rasmga qarang, so‘zni ichingizda bo‘g‘inlab ayting va harflarni tering. Ortiqcha harflar ham bor!

title.uz: Kelasi zamon: will va be going to
title.en: Future: will and be going to
title.ru: Будущее время: will и be going to

theory.uz:
will + fe’l — bashorat, shu zahoti qilingan qaror, va’da: It will rain tomorrow. I'll help you!
Qisqa shakl: I'll, she'll; inkor: won't (will not): We won't be late.
be going to + fe’l — oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish yoki aniq belgi:
I'm going to visit my aunt on Sunday. Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Savol: Will you come? — Yes, I will.  Are you going to play? — Yes, I am.
Kalit so‘zlar: tomorrow, next week, next year, soon, in the future.

Nima bo‘ldi? — What's the matter? / What's wrong?
I've got a headache (boshim og‘riyapti), a sore throat (tomog‘im), a cold (shamollash), a cough (yo‘tal),
a temperature (isitma), toothache (tish og‘rig‘i), stomach ache (qorin og‘rig‘i).
My leg hurts. — Oyog‘im og‘riyapti.  I feel ill. — O‘zimni yomon his qilyapman.
Maslahat — should: You should see a doctor. You shouldn't eat too many sweets.
Dori — medicine; britancha dorixona — the chemist's. Get well soon! — Tezroq tuzalib keting!

should — maslahat (… qilgan ma’qul): You should wear a coat.  shouldn't — qilmagan ma’qul.
have to / has to — majburiyat, qoida: I have to wear a uniform. She has to get up early.
don't have to — shart emas: We don't have to go to school on Sunday.
mustn't — mumkin emas, taqiq: You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
Diqqat: mustn't (taqiq) va don't have to (shart emas) — ma’nosi har xil!  O‘tgan zamon: had to — I had to wait.

Tana a’zolari: head (bosh), eye (ko‘z), ear (quloq), nose (burun), mouth (og‘iz), tongue (til),
tooth (tish), hand (qo‘l panjasi), foot (oyoq panjasi), shoulder (yelka), back (bel, orqa).
Ichki a’zolar: brain (miya), heart (yurak), muscle (mushak), bone (suyak).
Maxsus ko‘plik: tooth → teeth, foot → feet.  We see with our eyes and hear with our ears.

Qiyosiy daraja: -er / more + than: A plane is faster than a train. This book is more interesting than that one.
Orttirma daraja: the -est / the most: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Maxsus: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst.
as … as — xuddi … dek (teng): Anvar is as tall as his father.
not as … as — … chalik emas: A bike isn't as fast as a car.

Qarama-qarshi sifatlar: big — small, long — short, hot — cold, fast — slow,
old — young, happy — sad, loud — quiet, open — closed.
Taqqoslashda ham ishlatamiz: A snail is slower than a rabbit. The Arctic is colder than the desert.
not as … as bilan: A mouse isn't as big as a cat. = A mouse is smaller than a cat.

Do‘konda: How much is it? / How much are they? — It's £5. / They're £3.50 (three pounds fifty).
Can I help you? — Yes, I'd like a T-shirt, please. Can I try it on? Here's your change.
much — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan (money, water, time), many — sanaladigan (apples, shops):
How much money? How many books?  a lot of — ikkalasi bilan: a lot of people, a lot of sugar.
some — darak gapda, any — savol va inkorda, no = not any: There's no milk. = There isn't any milk.

Qurilmalar: computer, laptop (noutbuk), tablet (planshet), smartphone, screen (ekran), keyboard (klaviatura),
mouse (sichqoncha), printer, headphones (quloqchin), charger (quvvatlagich).
Harakatlar: switch on / switch off (yoqmoq / o‘chirmoq), type (terish), download (yuklab olish),
upload (joylash), save (saqlash), send a message, search the internet.
Xavfsizlik: password (parol) — uni hech kimga aytmang! Notanish odamlarga shaxsiy ma’lumot yubormang.

title.uz: Present Perfect: ever, never, just, already

theory.uz:
Present Perfect — have / has + fe’lning 3-shakli (V3): I have visited Bukhara. She has finished her work.
To‘g‘ri fe’llarda V3 = -ed: play → played. Noto‘g‘ri: see → seen, be → been, eat → eaten, do → done,
write → written, go → gone, take → taken.
Tajriba: Have you ever been to Khiva? — Yes, I have. / No, I've never been there.
just — hozirgina: I've just had lunch.  already — allaqachon: She has already done her homework.
yet — hali (savol va inkorda, gap oxirida): Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.

Muammolar: pollution (ifloslanish), rubbish (axlat), plastic, cutting down trees, wasting water (suvni isrof qilish).
Yechimlar: recycle (qayta ishlash), reuse (qayta foydalanish), reduce (kamaytirish), plant trees,
save water and energy (suv va energiyani tejash).
Maslahatlar: We should turn off the lights. We shouldn't drop litter. Take a reusable bag to the shop.
Tabiat: forest, river, lake, desert, ocean, air, wildlife (yovvoyi tabiat).

Tabiat: mountain (tog‘), desert (cho‘l), island (orol), volcano (vulqon), forest (o‘rmon), sea (dengiz).
Hayvonlar va qushlar: eagle (burgut), owl (boyqush), dolphin (delfin), whale (kit), crocodile (timsoh).
Hasharotlar: bee (asalari), butterfly (kapalak), ant (chumoli), spider (o‘rgimchak).
Misol: Bees are very important for flowers and fruit trees.

Uzun matnni o‘qishdan oldin sarlavha yoki birinchi gapga qarang — matn nima haqida?
Savolni o‘qing va kalit so‘zni (ism, son, joy, vaqt) matndan qidiring.
Javob ba’zan boshqa so‘zlar bilan berilgan bo‘ladi: “felt much better” = “got well”.
True / False: fikrning hamma qismi matnga mos kelsagina — To‘g‘ri.
